title: Fluid Builder Methods
goal: Implement builder methods that enable method chaining by value.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Builder Pattern

hints: Method chaining requires returning the builder value back to the caller.
Modifying fields on `self` requires a mutable binding for `self`.
explanation: Builder methods that take `mut self` by value gain mutable access to update fields and return `Self` to allow method chaining. Taking `&self` fails with `E0594` because immutable references cannot mutate fields. Taking un-mutable `self` also fails with `E0594` because the `self` variable itself must be declared `mut` to mutate its fields. Returning `()` causes `E0308` type mismatch and prevents chaining `.build()`.
